# Pull Request

## Description

Provide a clear and concise description of the changes in this pull request and the
motivation behind them.

## Related Issues

Link any issues this pull request addresses (for example, `Closes #123`).

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Build, CI, or tooling change

## Checklist

- [ ] I have described my changes clearly above.
- [ ] I have linked any related issues.
- [ ] My code follows the project's coding guidelines and uses single quotes for strings.
- [ ] I have documented functions, interfaces, and classes with JSDoc where appropriate.
- [ ] I have added every user-facing string to both `en.json` and `id.json`.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with no errors.
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run lint:fsd` pass with no errors.
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] I have manually verified the affected screens on Android and/or iOS (Expo Go or a development build).
- [ ] I have not committed any secrets, mnemonics, private keys, PINs, or a real `.env`.

## Screenshots or Notes

Add screenshots, recordings, or additional context for reviewers if relevant.
